description: List the districts of a city that have active listings (most cities have none). Use a district slug as `district` in search_listings.

country.description: Required. The city's region from list_cities, or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "DE"), or a city's region code where the site splits a country by state (e.g. "US-CA"). Get valid values from list_countries / list_cities.

name: list_districts
title: List districts
